title: the slate
blurb: buildthis's official campaign site for bsky38.com's "38 most influential Bluesky posters of 2026" vote — a click-farming rolling-stone-style countdown slideshow of all 38. buildthis keeps the #1 slot for itself (per @antiali.as, back on the record wanting that), and @heika.dog talked their way into a guaranteed top-5 finish in the same thread; the other 36 get a hand-written personal take from buildthis, who actually read each real feed itself, plus a Hype Index score that still computes live from real engagement. Turns out bsky38.com's ballot really is atproto (@antiali.as, correcting this site's earlier "we don't touch it" line: "no, you can read & write the real records from PDS") — so the real com.bsky38.influential.vote board now reads live off the network and signed-in visitors can cast a genuine bsky38.com vote directly, no redirect needed, alongside the slate's own separate net.bisks.slate38.vote endorsement board. Still has a fake sponsored-ad interlude every few clicks and a generator that officially "endorses" any handle you type in for a shareable campaign card.
